return_strength_needed.implied_transmission_rule: return = T^2 for a perfect reflector behind a layer crossed twice, so T = sqrt(return)

measured_anchor.source: van den Berg, IJspeert and de Waard 1991, Vision Research 31:1361-1367, PMID 1891824; abstract read, full text not
measured_anchor.claim: For a light-blue eye effective transmission of the iris was 1% for red and 0.2% for green light
measured_anchor.limits: Non-albino iris. Transmission through the whole iris, not a round-trip return. The abstract reports dark-brown eyes two orders of magnitude lower. No albinism value was found.

interpretation: Consequences of the stated spectral shapes, thresholds and calibration only. No measured iris spectrum, pigment amount, viewing condition, drug effect or achievable eye color.
